text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: Uhm, so, if we plug it into the formula on page 32 of the textbook and apply the theorem from page 31, the area S of △AEF is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuuurgh...
Th-This might be too hard for Falco...
Talking about As and Es and stuff, I don't get it at all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Alright!
For now, let's try replacing the shapes on the blackboard with everyday objects!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When I think of triangles, I think of sandwiches!
Triangle AEF represents the ham inside!
Which means finding its size is like...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Daaahhhh!! I don't get it!
How much ham you use depends on how big their appetite is, right?!
If someone eats a lot, you stack a bunch of slices!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sandwiches, huh~.
I think Falco prefers fruit sandwiches♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. If you like, I can explain it during the break.
If you stumble here, things will get rough later on.

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: In other words, area S is found with this multiplication, and if we reduce the numerator and denominator, the answer is...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Teacher.
Might there not be a more elegant solution to that problem?

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? Uh... is that so?
Would you mind coming up to the front and writing it down?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ――... It is finished.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"No way~! You solved it already!
You just rearranged the shapes? Without even using formulas!
That's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Even if you cut a sandwich and rearrange the pieces,
it's still a sandwich! That totally makes sense!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well then, may I consider this a correct answer as well?

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that is correct, but...
...This way of thinking belongs to the next curriculum.
I wonder if I should introduce it in class... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~, is that really a nooo?
Falco thought this was something she could totally do."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's got their own way of winning a duel.
Formula or no formula,
long as you solve it, it doesn't matter, right?"

"The intrigued students speak out all at once.
Unsure of what to do, the teacher paces
flustered in front of the podium."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hyek...!? Wh-What is it...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to be bound by convention.
Let the King hear all that you know regarding the solution to this problem.

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Outside the box...? As in, going beyond the curriculum?
Um... is that really okay? As a school teacher, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it fine?
After all, it is a direct request from a student.

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, quite. If it is a request from a student...
Perhaps Teacher shall show you her favorite solution.
Ehehe... hehe...

During recess, I visited the classroom
to deliver some documents to Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was such a fun lesson!
Looks like it really helped Falcon and the others understand better.
Thanks a ton!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Time is limited.
It's much more efficient to finish your studies during class.
choice_data_list: A true model of both brains and brawn.
You're a true model of both brains and brawn.
Wait, did you help out your rival or something...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Time is limited.
It's much more efficient to finish your studies during class.
choice_data_list: A true model of both brains and brawn.
You're a true model of both brains and brawn.
Wait, did you help out your rival or something...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... As the future head of the family,
something of this caliber is only to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You really are "strong."
I need to give it my all too.

Seeing her talk with her classmates like this,
it really hits home that even the "Steely Lady"
is just a normal student at heart.
choice_data_list: (Once again, this is a really "intense" class... Ah.)
(Once again, this is a really "intense" class... Ah.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh... I won't deny it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is a gathering place for the strong... Indeed, everyone must remain strong.
Having one's time consumed by remedial lessons is simply out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha... You really never waver, do you?

Seeing her talk with her classmates like this,
it really hits home that even the "Steely Lady"
is just a normal student at heart.
choice_data_list: (Once again, this is a really "intense" class... Ah.)
(Once again, this is a really "intense" class... Ah.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fuji~! Look at this!
My special Golshi-chan sweet whipped-cream gyoza
turned into hollow husks when I boiled 'eeem!
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, isn't she in the same class too?)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just when I wondered where you were, you've made another mysterious contraption.
Is it a present for McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I wrapped each one by hand, pouring in tons of love for Mac-chan! Where the heck did that bastard whipped cream go?!
choice_data_list: I think the heat from the hot water melted it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I would! Whip and I are bound by a meringue of friendship!
We promised that one day we'd become the filling in a taiyaki together!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, if that's how it is, I've got no choice but to search the whole school!
Wait for me, Whip-chwaaaaan!!
I'm coming to save you right noooowww!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll search too! Once I'm satisfied,
I'll do the review worksheets the teacher gave me.
It'd be awful if I had to take remedial classes!

Gold Ship and her crew tore away like a hurricane.
Looking down, I was left holding the discarded
wrapper(?) of a whipped-cream gyoza thrust upon me in the frenzy...
choice_data_list: What should I do about this...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well now. Why don't you do as you please?

There was no way Gentildonna would show any interest
in such a strange object. After she walked away,
the pre-bell chime echoed hollowly...
